## Rooted in Growing Firm Foundations

## Our Mission:

Oak Tree Support Services' mission is to create a world where every person receives the supports needed to allow for deep roots in the community resulting in a firm foundation to build their best life.

Through person-centered tools and planning, we support people to achieve the change they want in their lives.

## Our Vision:

Through person-centered state and federal programs, we strive to eradicate homelessness by meeting people where they are and helping them get to where they want to be.

## Request Services from Oak Tree Support Services

See what services we offer in your state

### Universal Referral Form

Submit a referral for any of our services from one form.

Submit Universal Referral Form

### Transitional Moving Services (TMS)

TMS is a great service provided by waivers that allows for payment and facilitation of movers, moving truck, moving supplies, and a small pool of money for furniture and household goods.

Complete TMS Referral

## Connect With Us

To submit a referral for any of our services, please use our Universal Referral Form.

Universal Referral Form

Or if you have specific questions for our staff, please use our Contact Form.

Contact Us

## Success Stories

## Doris

Doris

Doris had lived in her current apartment for ten years. She was thriving and had overcome struggles with anxiety and mobility limitations. She began services with OTSS when her landlord notified her that in three months, her lease would not be renewed, and that the owner was selling the property. Doris and her housing coordinator…

## Laura

Laura

After overcoming multiple barriers, we found Laura a place that would take her non-declawed cats, her voucher, and in an area that she loved and had a great school for her daughter!

## Holly

Holly

Holly was living with her abusive husband because she was unable to find a local shelter with an opening that could accommodate her accessibility needs. In addition to the stressful home environment and urgent need, Holly also had many barriers related to finding a new home. The housing coordinator was able to work with her…

## Sarah

Sarah

Sarah was in a group home that became increasingly unbearable. I was able to locate housing for her and when I went to visit her, she said she needed to move that day. I packed her up myself, drove the U-haul truck, and moved her things into her new home. It was an adventure but…

## Gretta

Gretta

Gretta was at severe risk of homelessness. Through a joint effort of HSS Transition, Sustain, and Employment Services, she is now able to grow her independence and stability through obtaining a firm foundation of housing and employment.

## Bob

Bob

Bob had not lived on his own in many years and found new independent housing through our HSS Transition services. He and his team identified that independent housing would be challenging without supports. Through HSS Sustain, he was able to help his team set up housekeeping and nursing supports. title: Oak Haven Support Services | Compassionate Care for Youth
text:
Oak Haven Support Services | Compassionate Care for Youth

## Building Confidence, One Step At A Time

Understanding and embracing the young person’s individual needs, building loving and meaningful relationships and teaching each individual to believe in themselves and recognise their self-worth.

### Compassionate Care, Built Around You

At Oak Haven Support Services, we are dedicated to making a meaningful difference in the lives of those who need it most. Our mission is to create safe, supportive, and empowering environments for young people and individuals who require care. With a focus on respect, dignity, and personalised attention, we strive to help every individual reach their fullest potential.

### Why Choose Oak Haven?

#### Personalised, Professional Support

We understand that every individual is unique. That’s why we create tailored support plans that meet the emotional, physical, educational, and social needs of those we care for.

#### Trauma-Informed Care

Our team is trained in trauma-aware practices, ensuring that we approach care with sensitivity, compassion, and a genuine understanding of each individual’s experiences.

#### A Holistic Approach to Well-Being

At Oak Haven, we don’t just focus on care—we’re dedicated to fostering personal growth, independence, and a sense of community. From education to recreation, we provide opportunities for individuals to build brighter futures every step of the way.

#### Celebrating Achievements

Success deserves recognition. Whether it’s a big accomplishment or a small breakthrough, we celebrate achievements to inspire confidence, pride, and a strong sense of self-worth.

### Our Commitment

Oak Haven was founded on the belief that everyone deserves to feel safe, valued, and supported. Whether it’s a young person overcoming challenges or an individual seeking compassionate assistance, we provide personalised care designed to uplift and empower.

We are proud to operate homes like Peacock House, one of our flagship properties. Here, we deliver high-quality residential care for young people aged 8-16 in a nurturing environment that promotes healing, growth, and brighter futures. Peacock House exemplifies our commitment to excellence and serves as a shining example of the values we uphold in every aspect of our work.

### We create a secure, supportive, and inviting space where every young person feels at home.

Our commitment is to create a lasting, positive impact on their lives, extending far beyond their time with us.
